name: Kimi to Futari de Otona ni Naru Hi
original_name: 君とふたりで大人になる日
source:
Hirose and Hinata were given birth in the supernatural users families.
So they are destined to follow traditional rules of the special bloodlines...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184370.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
广濑和日向出生于异能者家庭。
所以他们注定要遵循特殊血统的传统规则……
